name: System Status 3 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a system.

ACTV.name: Active
ACTV.definition: System is functioning normally, that is, operational.

CLSD.name: Closed
CLSD.definition: System is closed (eg. normal closure of an RTGS).

RMPS.name: Reserve Maintenance Period Start
RMPS.definition: System is starting a new maintenance period.
